We promise you: Chongqing will electrify your senses and tantalise your taste buds.

programme.title: China Untapped: Suzhou
programme.desc: CGTN’s integrated media cultural and travel program "China Untapped: Suzhou" features industrial tourism as its core theme, complemented by Jiangnan cultural tourism. The show follows a narrative thread of a foreign host touring the city alongside an international business investor. Serving as an explorer and guide, host Alex McCutcheon leads the entire industrial tour across Suzhou. UK businessman Athan Fox, acting as a potential investor and observer, views the city through the lens of commercial inspection and identifies the core strengths and investment potential of Suzhou’s high-end manufacturing sector. The production team traveled across Suzhou’s urban districts, Taicang, Kunshan, Changshu and other areas, visiting over 30 enterprises, research institutions and cultural tourism sites. The program presents a perfect blend of robust industrial strength and the exquisite aesthetics of Jiangnan. The two perspectives complement and validate each other, enabling global audiences to learn about Suzhou’s industrial achievements and unique charm in a way that resonates with their cognitive habits.

The episode also follows the rise of BUHURT, a European-style armored combat sport now gaining traction in China, featuring locally made traditional Chinese armour in intense full-contact bouts. Through Kleber’s own multicultural martial arts studio and the city’s everyday East-West blend, the episode shows Shanghai as a global hub, a place where classical martial arts find new life and cross-cultural practices thrive.

programme.title: I'M LIVE - 10CM
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter 10CM! 10CM is a solo act that initially started a band consisting of two members. The name referred to the height difference between them - 10 cm. In 2017 however one had to leave the group due to personal reasons and the main vocalist Kwon Jung-yeol continued on as a one-person band on his own under the name 10CM. In March 10CM held the first #TogetherAtHome concert in Korea after watching Coldplay singer Chris Martin perform a live concert online for people stuck indoors due to the spread of the coronavirus. Then in October the artist held a real-time online solo performance for the first time as a non-idol musician. In this episode 10CM performs songs from his latest album Winter Breath and Before Our Night Is Over as well as his hits pet Phonecert and Stalker to delight our ears and souls. Tune in to I'm LIVE this week and fill your heart with Christmas vibes with 10CM!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Lim Heon-il
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Lim Heon-il! This artist made his big debut in the music scene after winning the Bronze Award at the 15th Yoo Jae-ha Music Contest in 2004. Since then he has actively pursued his career both as a guitarist and vocalist. As a guitarist he has played for a number of Korea's top artists including Kim Dong-ryul Lim Jae-beom and Lee So-ra. He's also been part of many renowned bands such as iamnot Mate Jeong Won-young Band and Band Bremen. Then in 2013 this artist transformed into a solo artist with the album Becoming a Love. Last year Lim Heon-il took part in Begin Again Season 3 and once again showed off his prowess as a guitarist and vocalist. Then in April this year he released his second album Breathe after a break of 7 years. All the songs in the album were composed written and produced by Lim Heon-il himself perfectly quenching listeners' thirst. In this episode Lim Heon-il performs Leave Home and Everything from his new album RBTY and many other songs to delight viewers. Tune in to I'm LIVE and enjoy the essence of his artistry!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - ONEWE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the talented quintet ONEWE! ONEWE is an alternative rock band composed of YongHoon KangHyun HaRin DongMyeong and CyA. The band's name is a combination of one and and we shine on you which speaks to the members' ambition to shine on everyone and become one in the name of music. With exceptional talents in songwriting and lyric-writing the five young musicians never fail to impress listeners. Not surprisingly the quintet is expanding their audience reach both at home and abroad and their single Q entered the Billboard World Digital Song Sales Chart in April last year. Each member boasts his own distinctive musical talents so their music is versatile and kaleidoscopic yet harmonious. In this episode ONEWE performs Regulus Crazy ONEWE Medley and more to show off their musicality. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet these talented ambitious five artists!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Jung Seung-hwan
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is superb vocalist Jung Seung-hwan! With his trademark heartwarming voice this artist is known for his winter songs including The Snowman and My Christmas Wish. In time for the season he's back with another winter classic - Winter Again. Topping all the major charts with his latest single he once again proved his mainstream popularity. Also he took part in the song Our Christmas Wish For You released by his label and genuinely comforted listeners going through this difficult time. In this episode Jung Seung-hwan performs The Snowman Whenever Wherever Fine and more to keep us warm during this cold season. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented vocalist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - JEONG SEWOON
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter JEONG SEWOON! Known for his exceptional songwriting skills and talents this artist has been nourishing the ears and souls of listeners since his official debut in 2017. In July last year JEONG SEWOON released his first full-length album 24. Composed of Part 1 and Part 2 it's filled with his ambition and passion for music. In particular the lead single In the Dark tells listeners that regardless of the situation they can shine brightly eventually offering a genuine message of hope. In this episode JEONG SEWOON performs In the Dark :m(MIND) Be a Fool and more to showcase his mature musicality. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented musician!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Car, the garden
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Car the Garden! This artist made his big debut in the music industry in 2013 under the name Mason the Soul. Then in 2017 he changed his stage name to Car the Garden a literal translation of his name Cha Jeong-won and pleasantly surprised everyone in indie circles with his unique voice and dream-like sounds. The following year he became the final winner of the fan-voting audition program The Fan and further secured his position in the industry. Last month Car the Garden released his much-anticipated new album Absence. Featuring 5 tracks the album is filled with his distinct warm sounds and also showcases his growth as a musician. In this episode Car the Garden performs Tree Sarah and Home Sweet Home as well asMy Whole World and Doesn't Matter from his latest album. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Yang Da Il
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is a singer with a heartrending voice... Yang Da Il! This artist garnered much attention even before his official debut by taking part in Jung Key's songs Be Forgotten and This Intense Moment in 2011 as a guest vocalist. 4 years later in 2015 Yang Da Il made his official debut with the single Think and engraved his name in the minds of the public with his iconic heartrending voice. In January this year Yang Da Il released his second full-length album our joys and sadnesses to depict love and breakups. His new songs dominated the top spots of music charts and proved once again how beloved he is as a musician. In this episode Yang Da Il performs Loss Darling Sometimes Hurt and Sorry. Tune in to I'm LIVE this week and enjoy his depiction of love and separation!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Babylon
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is R&B musician Babylon! This artist made his big debut in 2015 with the single PRAY and immediately captured listeners' hearts with his unusual soulful vibes. Then he engraved his names in the minds of the public by featuring in ZICO's Boys And Girls which led him to collaborate with a number of top artists in the industry including Verbal Zint The Quiett Nucksal BewhY Suzy Chungha Yubin and more. This February Babylon returned to the industry with his much-anticipated new album Hardy packed to the brim with collaborations and songs. One of the lead singles Alone was written composed and produced by Lee Hyo-ri and another lead single Like Song features top rapper Jay Park. Babylon also worked with Kid Milli Coogie KYLE LO Samuel Seo Lee Young-ji Queen WA$ABII and more for the album. In this episode Babylon performs Like Song Dawn Fog Chandelier Red Lipstick and White Suit to showcase the essence of his musicality. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - MACGUFFIN
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the band MACGUFFIN! This band is composed of drummer SNOOQ vocalist and guitarist Byeon Ha-geum bassist UHI and guitarist Bae Joon-il. The band is named after a technique of the same name that advances a film's plot builds the narrative and helps push the story forward widely popularized by Alfred Hitchcock. Back in 2017 the quartet participated in the Arirang Competition and won the Grand Prize with their unique interpretation of Arirang. Then in 2018 they won the Golden Prize at the Penta Super Rookie and engraved their name in the minds of the public. The members recently completed their mandatory military duties and are so ready to impress listeners with their matured musicality. In this episode MACGUFFIN performs Sinpa Bucket List Highway and more to showcase their artistic prowess. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet these four talented musicians!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - GSoul
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the soulful singer-songwriter GSoul! GSoul is a big name in the music industry. Known for his exceptional soulful voice and songwriting skills he garnered much attention even before his official debut. To further engrave his name in the minds of the public he took part in the competition show “Voice Korea 2020” last year and won first place impressing everyone with his outstanding musicality once again. This past February this artist released the duet Can Love Be Fair? with Ben to depict a couple experiencing unequal love. GSoul's soulful vocals definitely make this song more heartrending. In this episode GSoul performs Hate Everything Bad Habits Let Me Know Another Sad Love Song Broken Record as well as his solo version of Can Love Be Fair? Tune in to I'm LIVE this week and let this artist melt your soul!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Kwon Jin-ah
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Kwon Jin-ah! This artist became known to the public in 2013 after taking part in K-Pop Star Season 3. 3 years later in 2016 she made her official debut with the album One Strange Night and topped all the music charts with the lead single The End. Particularly known for her delicate ability to express emotions she has collaborated with various top-notch musicians and also taken part in many soundtracks. This past February Kwon Jin-ah released her first collaborative single with Gaeko I Feel Like and dominated the top spots of music charts again. February was definitely a busy month for this artist - she also released her EP The Way For Us. Due to her active participation in the creative process both as a songwriter and producer the album beautifully displays her distinct musicality. She likens each of her songs in the EP to a short story making her new album a collection of 6 short stories. In this episode Kwon Jin-ah performs Something's Wrong Flower Heart You already have Good Bye I got lucky and The way for Us. Tune in to I'm LIVE and enjoy her beautiful songs!

programme.title: SEGMEN HARMONIKA (1700-1900)
programme.desc:
Harmonika merupakan segmen siaran petang ke malam KENINGAUfm yang menekankan keharmonian emosi, muzik dan kehidupan. Bersiaran dari jam 5 hingga 7 malam, segmen ini menjadi pengiring setia pendengar ketika waktu pulang dari kerja, dalam perjalanan, atau berehat bersama keluarga menjelang malam.

Segmen ini menyajikan lagu-lagu malar segar, balada, nostalgia dan pilihan pendengar yang menenangkan jiwa, diselang-selikan dengan perkongsian santai, refleksi ringan dan kisah kehidupan yang menyentuh perasaan. 

Harmonika turut membuka ruang interaksi dua hala melalui dedikasi lagu, kiriman mesej dan ucapan daripada pendengar, menjadikan segmen ini dekat dan peribadi. Di samping hiburan, segmen ini menyelitkan kata-kata positif, nilai kekeluargaan dan mesej kemanusiaan, sesuai untuk menutup hari dengan rasa damai dan seimbang.

Segmen ini bukan sekadar hiburan muzik, tetapi sebuah ruang harmoni yang menyatukan perasaan, kenangan dan harapan pendengar dalam alunan petang menuju malam.

programme.title: SEGMEN RENTAK SEGAR (0600-0900)
programme.desc: Segmen Rentak Segar – Permulaan Hari dengan Energi Positif di KENINGAUfm! Rentak Segar merupakan segmen siaran Bahasa Malaysia yang membuka tirai pagi di KENINGAUfm, bersiaran setiap hari dari pukul 6:00 hingga 9:00 pagi. Segmen ini menjadi pilihan utama pendengar di pedalaman Sabah untuk memulakan hari dengan maklumat terkini, hiburan, dan motivasi pagi yang segar.

programme.title: SEGMEN DUSUN-KUHOI ARAMAI BOH (0900-1200)
programme.desc: Kuhoi Aramai Boh merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Dusun yang bersifat ceria, mesra komuniti dan sarat nilai budaya, disiarkan setiap pagi dari jam 9 hingga 12 tengah hari. Segmen ini menjadi ruang kebersamaan untuk pendengar berkongsi cerita, gelak tawa, dan maklumat bermanfaat dalam suasana santai seperti berkumpul sesama keluarga.\n\nSepanjang tempoh siaran, pendengar disajikan dengan lagu-lagu Dusun dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berunsur hiburan, motivasi dan kehidupan seharian, serta perkongsian isu komuniti setempat. Interaksi langsung bersama pendengar melalui panggilan telefon, WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu mengukuhkan hubungan dua hala antara penyampai dan komuniti.

programme.title: SEGMEN MURUT- PAGAYAMAN TAKAW MONSOI (1200-1500)
programme.desc:
Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Murut yang mengangkat semangatperkongsian dan kebersamaan yang harmoni bersama komuniti. Bersiaran setiap hari dari jam 12 hingga 3 petang.

Segmen ini mengetengahkan lagu-lagu Murut dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berkenaan kehidupan harian, budaya, adat resam serta kisah komuniti pedalaman, di samping perkongsian maklumat semasa yang dekat dengan realiti pendengar. 

Interaksi dua hala menjadi kekuatan utama Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi melalui panggilan telefon, pesanan WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu, sekali gus memberi ruang kepada pendengar untuk bersuara, berkongsi cerita dan menyampaikan salam kekeluargaan. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata nasihat, nilai murni dan mesej kemasyarakatan, menjadikannya bukan sahaja menghiburkan, malah menyatukan dan memperkukuh jati diri komuniti dikawasan Pedalaman.

programme.title: SEGMEN SANTAI PETANG (1500-1700)
programme.desc:
Santai Petang merupakan segmen siaran yang menemani pendengar KENINGAUfm pada waktu peralihan dari rutin kerja ke suasana petang yang lebih tenang. Bersiaran dari jam 3 hingga 5 petang, segmen ini membawa pendekatan santai, ringan dan menghiburkan, sesuai dinikmati ketika dalam perjalanan pulang, berehat di rumah atau masih di tempat kerja.

Segmen ini menghidangkan lagu-lagu pilihan tempatan dan popular, diselang-selikan dengan sembang santai, perkongsian kisah harian, isu ringan semasa, serta topik-topik dekat dengan kehidupan pendengar.

Interaksi bersama pendengar menjadi elemen utama Santai Petang, melalui kiriman WhatsApp, dedikasi lagu dan respons spontan terhadap pandangan pendengar. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata motivasi ringkas, info bermanfaat dan mesej positif, menjadikan ia bukan sekadar hiburan, tetapi juga ruang untuk melepaskan tekanan dan menutup hari dengan emosi yang lebih baik.

programme.title: SEGMEN HARMONIKA (1700-1900)
programme.desc:
Harmonika merupakan segmen siaran petang ke malam KENINGAUfm yang menekankan keharmonian emosi, muzik dan kehidupan. Bersiaran dari jam 5 hingga 7 malam, segmen ini menjadi pengiring setia pendengar ketika waktu pulang dari kerja, dalam perjalanan, atau berehat bersama keluarga menjelang malam.

Segmen ini menyajikan lagu-lagu malar segar, balada, nostalgia dan pilihan pendengar yang menenangkan jiwa, diselang-selikan dengan perkongsian santai, refleksi ringan dan kisah kehidupan yang menyentuh perasaan. 

Harmonika turut membuka ruang interaksi dua hala melalui dedikasi lagu, kiriman mesej dan ucapan daripada pendengar, menjadikan segmen ini dekat dan peribadi. Di samping hiburan, segmen ini menyelitkan kata-kata positif, nilai kekeluargaan dan mesej kemanusiaan, sesuai untuk menutup hari dengan rasa damai dan seimbang.

Segmen ini bukan sekadar hiburan muzik, tetapi sebuah ruang harmoni yang menyatukan perasaan, kenangan dan harapan pendengar dalam alunan petang menuju malam.

programme.title: SEGMEN RENTAK SEGAR (0600-0900)
programme.desc: Segmen Rentak Segar – Permulaan Hari dengan Energi Positif di KENINGAUfm! Rentak Segar merupakan segmen siaran Bahasa Malaysia yang membuka tirai pagi di KENINGAUfm, bersiaran setiap hari dari pukul 6:00 hingga 9:00 pagi. Segmen ini menjadi pilihan utama pendengar di pedalaman Sabah untuk memulakan hari dengan maklumat terkini, hiburan, dan motivasi pagi yang segar.

programme.desc: Segmen Santai 5-8 mengandungi zon muzik segmen Lagu 60 an pada Isnin Laguku Kuasa Dua pada Selasa Rabu Lagu dan Kenangan Khamis Secangkir Bicara/Nurul Al-Quran dan Jumaat La Khobar. Sabtu dan Ahad segmen Hello Hello MELAKAfm pilihan lagu dan ucapan pendengar

programme.title: GEGAU PAGI 6-10
programme.desc: Seri Pagi dimulakan dengan Bacaan Al-Quran & Terjemahan seterusnya rancangan Permata Hati dan Kapsul Motivasi Jana Minda. Info Cuaca dan Berita MELAKAfm. Info trafik(call out) dan Topik Gegau Pagi interaktif bersama pendengar.Kokenut Shake Dulu Special (Temubual/Zon Iklan menyusul selepasnya. Pada Hari Sabtu pula rancangan Yok Donga Be bersiaran melibatkan tiga negeri Zon Selatan iaitu Melaka, Negeri Sembilan dan Johor secara interaktif. Sementara pada Hari Ahad Mari Berpantun(interaktif)seni budaya warisan kita.

programme.title: Pesona 10-2
programme.desc: Pendengar berpeluang memberi ucapan kepada orang yang tersayang dan membuat permintaan lagu menerusi ruangan Laguku Untukmu, bermula jam 11 pagi. Turut disajikan rancangan Dialog 1:30, program temu bual bersama Jabatan Kerajaan dan agensi-agensi berkaitan dengan memfokuskan topik-topik berkaitan situasi semasa. Rancangan keagamaan seperti Mutiara Ilmu, Fiqh Nisa dan Dari Kamar Syariah pula diserikan pada setiap Jumaat.

programme.title: Panorama 2-5
programme.desc: Santai bersama lagu-lagu tempatan dan antarabangsa terbaik menerusi ruangan 'Zon Muzik setiap Isnin jam 3 petang. Pada setiap Selasa, info-info menarik mengenai kenderaan dikongsikan menerusi rancangan 'Vromm??'. Pendengar juga akan menikmati keindahan warisan budaya negeri Melaka menerusi 'Dondang Sayang' jam 3 petang, Rabu dan 'Persada Pantun' jam 3 petang, Khamis. Turut disajikan rancangan keagamaan seperti 'Secangkir Bicara: Biar Santai Janji Sampai' dan 'Nurul Quran' \"La khobar\"pada setiap Jumaat. Sabtu dan Ahad diserikan dengan Silang Budaya/Stesen Berkembar Suara Bertemu Suara Satu Suara Satu Jiwa.

programme.title: Relaks Mfm 8-12
programme.desc: Hangatkan malam Isnin anda dengan seleksi lagu terbaik menerusi 'Janji Rock' bersama DJ Lia. 'Salam Namaste' pula menemui anda setiap Selasa dengan seleksi lagu-lagu Bollywood dan Hindustan. 'Layan Muzik' akan menghiburkan malam Rabu dengan Santai Buskers dan juga Dari Studio Muzik. Seleksi lagu-lagu ketuhanan melayari Khamis malam Jumaat anda. Turut Hangatkan malam Isnin anda dengan seleksi lagu terbaik menerusi 'Janji Rock' bersama DJ Lia. 'Salam Namaste' pula menemui anda setiap Selasa dengan seleksi lagu-lagu Bollywood dan Hindustan. 'Layan Muzik' akan menghiburkan malam Rabu dengan rancangan IN-TREND pilihan lagu-lagu baru. Seleksi lagu-lagu dalam Senada Duet melayari malam Khamis anda Malam Bunga Bunga Cinta untuk yang curhat pada malam Jumaat bersama DJ Ain. Turut disajikan 'Waronk Dangdut pada Sabtu dan Syok 80-90 pada Ahad.

programme.title: Best Of Pets
programme.desc: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: Super eye-catching! Herbivorous animal celebrity appears?! Delicate pets being snubby! They get angry if there's no air conditioning?! Genius horse trainer challenges the rapport between human and horses?! Fresh grass is so sweet that even humans love to eat it?! Growing up with sheep! Experts reveal the secrets of sheep?!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr. Matt travels to the moors above Whitby on the Yorkshire Coast to treat Bobo, an eight-year-old Capuchin. Meanwhile Samantha the scarlet macaw rules the roost and is displaying complete disobedience.

programme.title: My House And Other Animals
programme.desc: Meet the modern-day Dr Doolittles with a passion for all creatures great and small: the unsung heroes of the wildlife world, whose homes have become havens for every animal imaginable.

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Samoyed dogs, known as "smiling angels" are in fact not easy to raise. They require enough love and dedication, especially extraordinary physical strength!!! For you to be happy and healthy with them. If you want to raise a Samoyed, or already own one, we hope you can give them the best care and love, and make them your best partners. Come and jot notes of the hard work and tears shared by expert owners :)!

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: The funniest cat videos on the internet are celebrated in this hilarious compilation show. From humble moggies terrorised by the toaster or getting stuck in a hamster ball -V to Grumpy Cat, whose trademark scowl has earned her more cash than a Hollywood A-lister.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In the heart of London, Inspector Callum Isitt teams up with the police to track down four dogs, including two St Bernard types that have allegedly been beaten by their owners. One trail leads Callum to bustling Parliament Square, where it’s believed the St Bernard types are being used to get passers-by to part with their cash. Will he manage to find the dogs that he is looking for?

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Early morning - and Dr. Matt is on a routine visit to Flamingoland, near Malton, in North Yorkshire. As a specialist in exotic animals, he oversees the care of all the park's unusual inhabitants. Today, Matt's in for some donkey work. He's down on the children's farm for a spot of dentistry on a young donkey that proves to be a bit of a handful.

programme.title: Scruffts
programme.desc:
Six dogs, six handlers, all competing in the world’s largest and most famous dog show: "Crufts".
But they are not the pedigree pooches who compete to be labelled "Best in Show". These are the loveable family pets competing to win the "Scruffts" title.

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Because of her love for cats, Claire carefully created a place called "There is a Cat at the Corner". While enjoying your meals and drinks, more than a dozen beautiful cats are strolling freely in the store, waiting to interact with you up close and enjoy a slow life with you. However, if you want to pet the cat yourself and win their favor, you must first understand the nature and preferences of cats! Claire also generously shares her “experiences in ruling over dozens of cats”, which is extremely precious. Novice cat lovers should come and have a look!

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: Talented tabbies, mischievous moggies and fabulous feline fails - they're all here, plus we're catching up with the stars of some of the web's most popular cat videos.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In The Wirral, Inspector Anthony Joynes is called out to a shocking case where nine year old German Shepherd Reo has been left with an awful skin condition. Despite scratching so much that her face is covered in open sores she is still able to muster a wag of the tail, but will she have the strength to overcome her painful condition?

programme.title: Best Of Pets
programme.desc: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: The meerkat king from "Madagascar" is funny, but meerkats in real life are well-behaved, cuddly and they heal our hearts! Pocket sized pets are currently all the rage, but there are details you need to pay attention to when raising them. For example, hedgehogs are highly defensive, timid sugar gliders will harm themselves without being next to their owners, and cute guinea pigs like Norman from the movie "The Secret Life of Pets" are easily abandoned due to being easy to obtain and raise, etc. Don't worry, experts will teach you how to raise them! Come to a restaurant in Kaohsiung to get up close with Rocket Raccoon from “The Avengers”!

What should beginners pay attention to when raising rabbits?! Shocking! Rabbits can be poisoned by eating carrots?! Rabbits have a very bad temper?! They kick people they don't like?! Crazy about rabbits! Caregivers takes care of the little rabbits "wholeheartedly"?!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: A lone cow has gone wild and escaped into a neighbouring field.Dr. Matt has been called in to lend a hand. The heifer " went wild" two months ago and various tactics are employed to get Matt close enough to get a good shot with his dart gun. But the wary cow wins the first round and escapes. Matt decides to return another day.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: Chief Inspector Cathy Hyde is on a warrant to access a property in Leigh, suspected of being involved in puppy trafficking. Cathy discovers two Jack Russell types and two Yorkshire Terriers. Tragically, they were too late one for one dog that had passed away and another has badly fractured leg. Will Cathy be able to provide the escape that these dogs desperately need?

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles. He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets. In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards. The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball. How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets. How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

programme.desc: An English-language food magazine programme exploring Malaysia’s diverse culinary landscape, featuring a variety of local dishes, flavours, food traditions and culinary experiences from across the country.

programme.title: DUNIA MELAYU - LEGASI MARITIM MELAYU
programme.desc: Legasi Maritim Melayu is a documentary segment under Dunia Melayu that explores the rich maritime heritage of the Malay civilisation. The programme highlights the ingenuity and achievements of the Malay people in navigation, shipbuilding, seafaring knowledge, and maritime trade, showcasing their historical role as skilled sailors and influential players in regional and international maritime networks.

programme.title: Mukjizat Dan Sains
programme.desc: A programme exploring the scientific and technological dimensions of selected Quranic verses, highlighting their relevance to modern scientific discoveries and knowledge. Hosted by Associate Professor Dato’ Dr. Mohd Izhar Ariff, the programme offers an insightful perspective on the relationship between the Quran, science and technology.

programme.title: Ilmuan Islamiah
programme.desc: A programme exploring the development of various fields of knowledge pioneered and advanced by prominent Islamic scholars and thinkers. Each episode features two influential figures — a historical scholar and a contemporary thinker — highlighting their contributions, ideas and lasting impact on their respective fields.

programme.title: Iqra'
programme.desc: A Quran learning programme focused on talaqqi and guided Quran reading, helping viewers of all ages learn to read the Quran correctly with proper tajwid and pronunciation.

programme.title: Nawaitu
programme.desc: A programme exploring the importance of intention (niat) as the foundation of every action, through real-life stories and experiences within society. It highlights how sincere intentions can transform good deeds into acts of worship, while misguided intentions may lead to unintended consequences, guided by teachings from the Quran and Hadith.

programme.title: Kata Sifu
programme.desc: A mentorship programme featuring accomplished experts from selected fields as Sifus (mentors) who share their knowledge, skills and experience with their mentees. Hosted by Wanns Ahmad, the programme offers an engaging platform for learning, guidance and personal growth.

programme.title: Kota Warisan Alam
programme.desc: A travelogue exploring Malaysia’s heritage cities, showcasing their unique history, culture, natural attractions and interesting places for visitors to discover. Each episode takes viewers on a journey through the country’s heritage destinations and highlights experiences worth exploring.

programme.title: Warisan Kita
programme.desc: An engaging programme for general audiences that showcases Malaysia’s rich heritage, highlighting the country’s diverse cultural traditions, customs, arts and historical legacy.

programme.title: Etnik Kita
programme.desc: A travelogue following host Alif Hadi as he journeys across Malaysia to discover the lives, cultures and traditions of the country’s minority ethnic communities, offering viewers a closer look at their unique heritage and way of life.

programme.title: Lagu Negaraku
programme.desc: Negaraku is the national anthem of Malaysia, symbolising the nation’s sovereignty, unity, and patriotism.

programme.title: GLOBAL - ON THE TABLE
programme.desc: In this latest episode of On The Table, the discussion explores how Artificial Intelligence (AI) is reshaping the future of work and transforming modern workplaces. The programme looks at the changing nature of jobs, evolving workplace skills, and how organisations and employees can adapt to an increasingly AI-driven working environment.

programme.title: Global - World Around Us
programme.desc: This episode (76), present various cultural traditions, agricultural shifts, and economic impacts around the globe, starting with the deep cultural importance of traditional Afghan flatbread (naan) as a staple of hospitality and daily life, alongside France's globally renowned cheese industry, which blends ancestral production methods with modern certification systems to protect its vital economic and heritage status. It also showcases Malaysia's tourism appeal through recurring promotional segments emphasizing its rich heritage and natural beauty. On the economic front, the video examines how the FIFA World Cup drives global commerce, particularly through Chinese manufacturers rapidly scaling the production of Lionel Messi plush toys to monetize high fan engagement. Additionally, it covers the strategic shift in northwest Syria's Idlib province toward low-water, high-value saffron cultivation to revive the war-torn economy, and concludes with the major resurgence of indigenous, nutrient-rich foods in Zimbabwe, where cities like Bulawayo are seeing an increase in traditional restaurants helping to promote healthier lifestyles and preserve national identity.

programme.title: GLOBAL PERSPECTIVE : MALAYSIA'S REGIONAL DIPLOMATIC EFFORTS
programme.desc: Under the leadership of Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim, Malaysia has prioritized an \"ASEAN First\" foreign policy centered on deepening diplomatic ties, honest communication, and mutual respect with its neighbors to bolster economic and regional stability. This cooperative framework is materialized through major high-value cross-border projects with Singapore, such as the Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone (JSSEZ) and the Rapid Transit System (RTS) Link, which aim to enhance digital economy integrations, secure sustainable skilled employment, and improve labor mobility. Furthermore, during its 2025 ASEAN Chairmanship focused on inclusivity and sustainability, Malaysia expanded the regional architecture by admitting Timor-Leste, charting the long-term \"ASEAN 2045\" strategic vision, and demonstrating its diplomatic efficacy by facilitating a swift 24-hour ceasefire between Cambodia and Thailand. Ultimately, these parallel security and geoeconomic strategies—such as releasing a historical communique regarding Palestine/Gaza and maintaining stable dialogue over the South China Sea—reinforce ASEAN centrality while driving Malaysia forward to attract major global investments and position Southeast Asia as a resilient, high-value global economic hub.

programme.title: ASEAN - RASA ASEAN
programme.desc: Rasa Asean, is a culinary travel program involving the tastes of food from Asean countries with Chef Fikri and Chef Naim who will also produce and serve the stories behind the traditional food.

programme.title: Asean Women Entrepreneurship
programme.desc: Episode 1 features the stories and entrepreneurial journeys of three women entrepreneurs from ASEAN — Christy Ng (Malaysia), Boutsaya Viengviseth (Laos), and Nikha Akhsaniyati Kholisoh (Indonesia) — as they build their businesses, overcome challenges, and unlock new opportunities. The programme highlights their entrepreneurial spirit, creativity, and the vital role of women in driving economic growth across the ASEAN region.

programme.title: ASEAN - JEJAK HALAL ASEAN
programme.desc: A travelogue exploring the diverse cultures, traditions and everyday lives of Muslim communities across ASEAN. This episode of Jejak Halal ASEAN takes viewers on a journey through Satun, Thailand, discovering its rich Islamic heritage, halal culture and unique local way of life.

programme.title: MUSLIM WORLD - KALAM WAHYU (TILAWAH)
programme.desc: Kalam Wahyu is a special segment under Muslim World featuring a compilation of Quran recitations from the 2024 International Quran Recitation and Memorisation Assembly. The programme showcases beautiful and melodic recitations by participants from Bosnia Herzegovina, Kazakhstan, Canada and India reflecting the diversity and unity of the Muslim world through the art of Quranic recitation.

programme.title: MUSLIM WORLD - SYAHADAH (UZBEKISTAN)
programme.desc: The Syahadah documentary series produced by RTM frequently features travel episodes highlighting the unique aspects and Islamic heritage of Uzbekistan. Key highlights previously broadcasted include stories of master carvers, Malaysia-Uzbekistan cultural ties, and journeys through historic locations such as Tashkent and Fergana.

programme.title: MUSLIM WORLD - KALAM WAHYU (HAFAZAN)
programme.desc: Kalam Wahyu is a special segment under Muslim World featuring a compilation of Quran memorisation recitations from the 2024 International Quran Recitation and Memorisation Assembly. The programme highlights participants from Ireland, Liberia, Mauritania and Somalia as they demonstrate their mastery and memorisation of the Holy Quran through specially tested recitation sessions.

programme.desc: An English-language food magazine programme exploring Malaysia’s diverse culinary landscape, featuring a variety of local dishes, flavours, food traditions and culinary experiences from across the country.

programme.title: DUNIA MELAYU - LEGASI MARITIM MELAYU
programme.desc: Legasi Maritim Melayu is a documentary segment under Dunia Melayu that explores the rich maritime heritage of the Malay civilisation. The programme highlights the ingenuity and achievements of the Malay people in navigation, shipbuilding, seafaring knowledge, and maritime trade, showcasing their historical role as skilled sailors and influential players in regional and international maritime networks.

programme.title: Mukjizat Dan Sains
programme.desc: A programme exploring the scientific and technological dimensions of selected Quranic verses, highlighting their relevance to modern scientific discoveries and knowledge. Hosted by Associate Professor Dato’ Dr. Mohd Izhar Ariff, the programme offers an insightful perspective on the relationship between the Quran, science and technology.

programme.title: Ilmuan Islamiah
programme.desc: A programme exploring the development of various fields of knowledge pioneered and advanced by prominent Islamic scholars and thinkers. Each episode features two influential figures — a historical scholar and a contemporary thinker — highlighting their contributions, ideas and lasting impact on their respective fields.

programme.title: Iqra'
programme.desc: A Quran learning programme focused on talaqqi and guided Quran reading, helping viewers of all ages learn to read the Quran correctly with proper tajwid and pronunciation.

programme.title: Nawaitu
programme.desc: A programme exploring the importance of intention (niat) as the foundation of every action, through real-life stories and experiences within society. It highlights how sincere intentions can transform good deeds into acts of worship, while misguided intentions may lead to unintended consequences, guided by teachings from the Quran and Hadith.

programme.title: Kata Sifu
programme.desc: A mentorship programme featuring accomplished experts from selected fields as Sifus (mentors) who share their knowledge, skills and experience with their mentees. Hosted by Wanns Ahmad, the programme offers an engaging platform for learning, guidance and personal growth.

programme.title: Kota Warisan Alam
programme.desc: A travelogue exploring Malaysia’s heritage cities, showcasing their unique history, culture, natural attractions and interesting places for visitors to discover. Each episode takes viewers on a journey through the country’s heritage destinations and highlights experiences worth exploring.

programme.title: Warisan Kita
programme.desc: An engaging programme for general audiences that showcases Malaysia’s rich heritage, highlighting the country’s diverse cultural traditions, customs, arts and historical legacy.

programme.title: Etnik Kita
programme.desc: A travelogue following host Alif Hadi as he journeys across Malaysia to discover the lives, cultures and traditions of the country’s minority ethnic communities, offering viewers a closer look at their unique heritage and way of life.

programme.title: Lagu Negaraku
programme.desc: Negaraku is the national anthem of Malaysia, symbolising the nation’s sovereignty, unity, and patriotism.

programme.title: GLOBAL - ON THE TABLE
programme.desc: In this latest episode of On The Table, the discussion explores how Artificial Intelligence (AI) is reshaping the future of work and transforming modern workplaces. The programme looks at the changing nature of jobs, evolving workplace skills, and how organisations and employees can adapt to an increasingly AI-driven working environment.

programme.title: Global - World Around Us
programme.desc: This episode (76), present various cultural traditions, agricultural shifts, and economic impacts around the globe, starting with the deep cultural importance of traditional Afghan flatbread (naan) as a staple of hospitality and daily life, alongside France's globally renowned cheese industry, which blends ancestral production methods with modern certification systems to protect its vital economic and heritage status. It also showcases Malaysia's tourism appeal through recurring promotional segments emphasizing its rich heritage and natural beauty. On the economic front, the video examines how the FIFA World Cup drives global commerce, particularly through Chinese manufacturers rapidly scaling the production of Lionel Messi plush toys to monetize high fan engagement. Additionally, it covers the strategic shift in northwest Syria's Idlib province toward low-water, high-value saffron cultivation to revive the war-torn economy, and concludes with the major resurgence of indigenous, nutrient-rich foods in Zimbabwe, where cities like Bulawayo are seeing an increase in traditional restaurants helping to promote healthier lifestyles and preserve national identity.

programme.title: GLOBAL PERSPECTIVE : MALAYSIA'S REGIONAL DIPLOMATIC EFFORTS
programme.desc: Under the leadership of Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim, Malaysia has prioritized an \"ASEAN First\" foreign policy centered on deepening diplomatic ties, honest communication, and mutual respect with its neighbors to bolster economic and regional stability. This cooperative framework is materialized through major high-value cross-border projects with Singapore, such as the Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone (JSSEZ) and the Rapid Transit System (RTS) Link, which aim to enhance digital economy integrations, secure sustainable skilled employment, and improve labor mobility. Furthermore, during its 2025 ASEAN Chairmanship focused on inclusivity and sustainability, Malaysia expanded the regional architecture by admitting Timor-Leste, charting the long-term \"ASEAN 2045\" strategic vision, and demonstrating its diplomatic efficacy by facilitating a swift 24-hour ceasefire between Cambodia and Thailand. Ultimately, these parallel security and geoeconomic strategies—such as releasing a historical communique regarding Palestine/Gaza and maintaining stable dialogue over the South China Sea—reinforce ASEAN centrality while driving Malaysia forward to attract major global investments and position Southeast Asia as a resilient, high-value global economic hub.

programme.title: ASEAN - RASA ASEAN
programme.desc: Rasa Asean, is a culinary travel program involving the tastes of food from Asean countries with Chef Fikri and Chef Naim who will also produce and serve the stories behind the traditional food.

programme.title: Asean Women Entrepreneurship
programme.desc: Episode 1 features the stories and entrepreneurial journeys of three women entrepreneurs from ASEAN — Christy Ng (Malaysia), Boutsaya Viengviseth (Laos), and Nikha Akhsaniyati Kholisoh (Indonesia) — as they build their businesses, overcome challenges, and unlock new opportunities. The programme highlights their entrepreneurial spirit, creativity, and the vital role of women in driving economic growth across the ASEAN region.

programme.title: ASEAN - JEJAK HALAL ASEAN
programme.desc: A travelogue exploring the diverse cultures, traditions and everyday lives of Muslim communities across ASEAN. This episode of Jejak Halal ASEAN takes viewers on a journey through Satun, Thailand, discovering its rich Islamic heritage, halal culture and unique local way of life.

programme.title: MUSLIM WORLD - KALAM WAHYU (TILAWAH)
programme.desc: Kalam Wahyu is a special segment under Muslim World featuring a compilation of Quran recitations from the 2024 International Quran Recitation and Memorisation Assembly. The programme showcases beautiful and melodic recitations by participants from Bosnia Herzegovina, Kazakhstan, Canada and India reflecting the diversity and unity of the Muslim world through the art of Quranic recitation.

programme.title: MUSLIM WORLD - SYAHADAH (UZBEKISTAN)

programme.title: Signal 1203
programme.desc: Signal 1203 – The Midnight Experience on REDfm\\\\n\\\\nGet ready for a brand-new late-night adventure with Signal 1203, your ultimate companion from 12am to 3am on REDfm for Variety! This isn’t just another radio show – it’s a full-on experience. Dive into fresh, youth-focused content, spine-chilling horror stories that will keep you on the edge of your seat, and trending topics that matter to you. We have Technology, Horror, chillout music, movie reviews, crime drama and so much more!\\\\n\\\\nAnd of course, what’s a night show without killer music? We’ve got the best tracks to keep your vibe alive through the early hours. Whether you’re up late studying, driving, or just chilling, Signal 1203 is your signal for something different.\\\\n\\\\nStay tuned. Stay awake. Stay connected. Only on REDfm – for variety.\\\\n\\\\n

programme.title: Morning Music 音乐早点
programme.desc: 《音乐早点》你最贴心的早间声音伴侣。我们不聊冗长的资讯，只精选最舒缓、最动听的旋律，配合清新的晨间絮语，为你卸去昨夜的疲惫，装满清晨的能量。无论你正行走在通勤的路上，还是在享用一份惬意的早餐，让《音乐早点》用惬意的乐音，陪你开启美好而有温度的一天。

programme.title: Midday Mix Part 1
programme.desc: Playing you the best hits from the past to current hits, along with news, interviews and interesting topics.

programme.title: Tech Me
programme.desc: A tech focused program with the latest updates on Tech news, Gaming and Gadgets. Every Monday at 12:15pm

programme.title: MIDDAY MIX PART 2
programme.desc: Our variety program for the afternoon. 1pm - 4pm. Great music, fun DJs and total entertainment for 3 hours!!

programme.title: 音乐下午茶Teabreak
programme.desc: 星期一道星期六，下午4-5点，忙碌的午后，需要适时的暂停。《音乐下午茶》 是一档专为午后时光打造的治愈系音乐随笔节目。

programme.title: 下班开麦啦
programme.desc: 叮！下班铃声响起，属于你自己的时间正式开始。《下班开麦啦》是你在晚高峰通勤路上最懂你的“解压陪伴站”。告别繁琐的工作汇报和烦人的KPI，这里只有轻松搞笑的职场吐槽、热辣接地气的社会热议，以及最治愈的音乐与故事。无论你正挤在拥挤的地铁里，还是堵在回家的车流中，戴上耳机，和我们一起开麦畅聊，把一天的疲惫一扫而空！

programme.title: 听歌好时光
programme.desc: 忙碌的生活里，你有多久没有好好听完一首歌了？这里是《听歌好时光》，你的私享音乐会客厅。我们不设复杂的门槛，没有沉重的叙事，只挑选最惬意、最动听的旋律，为你揉碎日常的喧嚣。沏一杯清茶，或是斟一杯咖啡，在这个专属的空间里，让我们用好歌慢下来，静静享受属于你的好时光。

programme.title: 孤芳自赏
programme.desc: 在快节奏与商业大片的喧喧嚷嚷之外，总有一些电影选择安静地立于角落，散发着独一无二的光芒。这里是《孤芳自赏》，一处专属于高冷影迷与独立电影的声音（视觉）放映厅。\n\n我们带你穿透繁复的光影，解读那些被低估的冷门佳作、艺术大师的独行之作，以及镜头深处最隐秘的人性角落。不追热门，不作媚俗之语。今夜，让我们在独立的光影世界里，孤芳自赏。

programme.title: The Ice Cream Truck
programme.desc: Mary moves back to her suburban hometown as her husband is relocated there for work. programme.title: An Unquiet Grave
programme.desc: A year after Jamie's wife tragically died in a car accident, he persuades her sister, Ava, to accompany him to the accident site to perform a peculiar ritual. As the night progresses, it becomes evident that Jamie harbours sinister motives.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min dies mysteriously in a hospital rumoured to be haunted. Soon after, her photographer receives eerie phone calls, a writer suffers a bizarre car accident, and Min’s friend suddenly vanishes. As fear spreads, dark secrets and supernatural forces emerge, drawing them into a terrifying nightmare linked to Min’s death.

programme.title: Night at the Eagle Inn

As they dive deeper, the property's dark secrets ensnare them in a hellish labyrinth which they must escape before dawn.

programme.title: The Possession of Leah Dela Cruz

programme.desc: Model Min dies mysteriously in a hospital rumoured to be haunted. Soon after, her photographer receives eerie phone calls, a writer suffers a bizarre car accident, and Min’s friend suddenly vanishes. As fear spreads, dark secrets and supernatural forces emerge, drawing them into a terrifying nightmare linked to Min’s death.

programme.title: Circle of Bones
programme.desc: While investigating a series of cult ritual massacres, Philippine police rescue the sole survivor on Bohol Island, who is a former FBI agent living under a false identity. As the investigation deepens, her accounts of ancient prophecies, demonic possession and bloody rituals draw everyone into a terrifying mystery where reality blurs.

programme.title: Sinister - Live Art Model
programme.desc: Jing Wen, a struggling drama student, takes on a modelling job to help cover her tuition costs. programme.title: Sinister - Luk Krok
programme.desc: Si Nan and her husband travel to Kuala Lumpur for a vacation to relieve her pregnancy stress. However, she soon uncovers his evil plan to turn their child into a 'Luk Krok' for profit, which puts her in grave danger. With the help of the hotel ghosts, she manages to flee and alert the police to arrest him, finally giving birth to her child.

programme.title: The Ghost Writer
programme.desc: A struggling writer retreats to his childhood home to finish a novel and save his career. There, he uncovers the final manuscript left behind by his father, a famous writer who died mysteriously years earlier. Realizing the work is beyond his own talent, he decides to plagiarize it, unleashing horrifying supernatural events.

No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

Namun, pencarian mereka bertukar menjadi mimpi ngeri apabila setiap ahli kumpulan mula mengalami gangguan misteri, halusinasi dan kejadian yang sukar dijelaskan. Ketika rahsia gelap di sebalik Jerunei mula terbongkar, mereka terpaksa berdepan kuasa ghaib. Lakonan : Bront Palarae. Uqasha Senrose, Syafie Naswip, Amerul Affendi, Daiyan Trisha, Tony Eusoff dan ramai lagi.

programme.title: Gotham II
programme.desc: James Gordon merupakan seorang detektif yang sedang meningkat naik di Gotham City. Bapanya yang telah meninggal dunia, sebelum ini merupakan seorang peguam daerah yang berjaya. Berani, jujur dan bertekad untuk membuktikan kebolehannya, Gordon perlu berdepan dengan permainan politik kotor dalam sistem keadilan Gotham, selain kemunculan penjahat berbahaya. Lakonan : Ben McKenzie, Donal Logue, David Mazouz, Robin Lord Taylor, Cory Michael Smith dan ramai lagi.
